verdict.rationale: Reflect has a first-party REST API that scripts or CI jobs can call without the app UI, using bearer-token curl calls against reflect.app/api. Documented endpoints can append to daily notes, create notes and list or add links. The surface is narrow, though: end-to-end encryption means the API cannot read note contents, authentication is OAuth2 rather than simple service tokens, and there is no CLI or headless runtime. Deep links (reflect://) depend on the desktop app, so they do not count toward headless use. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, read access to note contents via API, CI-friendly service or API-key auth, and a sandbox or test environment plus versioning policy for automation.
